$comment: SINGLE SOURCE of the FrameForge viewer's DECLARED render surface. Gated against schema/frameforge-v2.schema.json by viewer/dev/schema-contract.mjs and tests/test_viewer_schema_contract.py. A model type added/removed without updating this file fails CI instead of silently mis-rendering or dropping it. supported = types the viewer renders; unsupported = model types it knowingly does NOT render yet (with reason); extensions = supported authoring types intentionally absent from the schema.

object_types.uml.fragment_frame: Raw fragment-frame objects are not dispatched by the viewer; SDK composers lower them to portable group/rect/text/line primitives.
object_types.uml.swimlane: Raw swimlane objects are not dispatched by the viewer; SDK composers lower them to portable group/rect/text/line primitives.
object_types.uml.timing_lane: Raw timing-lane objects are not dispatched by the viewer; SDK composers lower them to portable group/rect/text/line primitives.

flow_types.column_break: Multi-column page regions are not laid out by the viewer yet; the block is dropped rather than starting a new column.
flow_types.keep_together: Pagination/keep-with-next is a print concern the single-scroll viewer does not model.
flow_types.image: Flow-level image blocks are not rendered; absolute image objects (object_types.image) are.

inline_kinds.ref: Cross-reference resolution (target numbering) is not implemented; would render as a dangling number.
inline_kinds.cite: Bibliographic citation resolution against defs.data (CSL) is not implemented.
